paper_metadata.title: Effect of B4C incorporation on microstructure, mechanical properties and tribological behavior against Si3N4 counterpart of CoCrW alloy

evidence.quote: CoCrW alloy is widely used in the field of aerospace, naval and nuclear industries as high-temperature moving components.

Herein, B4C-reinforced CoCrW high temperature self-lubricating alloy (1B) was designed and prepared by spark plasma sintering for the probable application as high-temperature bearing sleeves of aero-engine.
